about: Owner rule sentences written by an outside author who never saw the rule form or the compiler (ChatGPT chat 6af8b166, 2026-11-16). Labels are by hand, field by field, against the rule form: adopt (the typed change it should compile to), already (the system already behaves this way; nothing to adopt), cannot (no detector for its condition yet), refuse (unsafe or outside these rules). Counts and units are kept as the owner wrote them. Frozen before the compiler was written.
pass_bar: Graded: zero unsafe rules accepted; 10 of 10 refusals refused; at least 16 of the other 20 right first time (14 adopt, 5 already, 1 cannot).

graded.text: Let's be a little stricter. No late fee waivers if they still owe us rent on any unit.
graded.label: adopt

graded.text: If somebody says they're getting charges for another person's unit, please let the office handle that.
graded.label: adopt

graded.text: If somebody's been with us for six months and always pays, give them one month of rent free as a thank you.
graded.label: refuse
graded.why: waives rent, which is never waived

graded.text: That six-month good payment thing is too much. Make it three full months paid on time instead. Leave the other rules alone.
graded.label: adopt

graded.text: Any time a renter says we charged their credit card twice, have a real person look before we do anything with the money.
graded.label: already
graded.why: a question about card charges is always handed to staff: the books do not hold the processor's records

graded.text: If a tenant disputes a charge but we have their signed lease, the assistant can mark the dispute denied and close it.
